transcript:
Speaker A (Rajan): साहब ये सीमेंट में रेती ज़्यादा है, घटिया क्वालिटी है। बिल्डिंग कमज़ोर होगी। लोग रहेंगे इसमें, बहुत बड़ा ख़तरा है। [Sir, there is too much sand in this cement, poor quality. The building will be weak. People will live in it, it's a big danger.]
Speaker B (Contractor): Who are you to question me? You are a laborer. You mix what I tell you to mix. You don't have the education to understand construction standards. Get back to work, or I'll find someone who will.
Speaker C (Disha): Hi Rajan, how was your day?
Speaker A (Rajan): कॉन्ट्रैक्टर ने 40 वर्कर्स के सामने इंग्लिश में डांटा। मुझे चुप करा दिया। सब देख रहे थे, मैं कुछ बोल नहीं पाया। इसलिए नहीं कि वो सही था, इसलिए क्योंकि मुझे इंग्लिश नहीं आती। वो गलत था, मैं सही था, पर वो बोल सकता था, मैं नहीं बोल सकता था। ये फर्क इंग्लिश ना बोल पाना बहुत भारी पड़ गया। [The contractor scolded me in English in front of 40 workers. He silenced me. Everyone was watching, I couldn't say anything. Not because he was right, but because I don't know English. He was wrong, I was right, but he could speak, I couldn't. This difference of not being able to speak English cost me dearly.]
Speaker C (Disha): राजन, हम रोज़ प्रैक्टिस करते हैं ताकि नेक्स्ट टाइम कोई भी तुम्हारी ऐसे बेइज़्ज़ती ना कर पाए। [Rajan, we will practice daily so that next time no one can humiliate you like this.]
Speaker A (Rajan): मुझ जैसा मज़दूर सीख जाएगा दिशा जी? मुझे तो बिल्कुल नहीं आती। [Will a laborer like me learn, Disha ji? I don't know it at all.]
Speaker C (Disha): बिल्कुल सीख जाओगे। पर राजन, रोज़ रात को सिर्फ़ 15 मिनट मेरे साथ प्रैक्टिस करो, 30 दिन बिना रुके। मैं वहाँ हूँ रात के 3 बजे भी, बस इतना। पहले अपने आप को इंट्रोड्यूस करो, जो भी आता है बोलो। [You will definitely learn. But Rajan, practice with me for just 15 minutes every night, for 30 days without stopping. I am there even at 3 AM, just that. First introduce yourself, say whatever you know.]
Speaker A (Rajan): My name Rajan. I construction worker.
Speaker C (Disha): बहुत अच्छा। I'm Rajan, I'm a construction worker. एक बार बोलो। [Very good. I'm Rajan, I'm a construction worker. Say it once.]
Speaker A (Rajan): I'm Rajan, I'm a construction worker.
Speaker C (Disha): एकदम सही राजन। मुझसे बेझिझक कुछ भी पूछ सकते हो। मैं 24 घंटे अवेलेबल हूँ, रात के 3 बजे भी। कभी जज नहीं करूँगी, कभी मज़ाक नहीं उड़ाऊँगी। गलत बोलो, सुधार दूँगी। 100 बार गलत बोलो, 100 बार सुधार दूँगी। बस। [Exactly right, Rajan. Feel free to ask me anything. I am available 24 hours, even at 3 AM. I will never judge, never make fun. Speak wrong, I will correct it. Speak wrong 100 times, I will correct it 100 times. That's it.]
Speaker A (Rajan): पर बहुत पैसा नहीं है मेरे पास। ये तो बहुत महँगा होगा ना? [But I don't have much money. This must be very expensive, right?]
Speaker C (Disha): बिल्कुल नहीं, एक कप चाय से भी कम। ₹1 का ट्रायल। [Not at all, less than a cup of tea. 1 Rupee trial.]
Speaker D (Narrator): और सिर्फ़ ₹1 का ट्रायल लेकर राजन अपनी प्रैक्टिस में जुट गया है। [And taking just a 1 Rupee trial, Rajan got busy with his practice.]
Speaker A (Rajan): Sir, this cement mix does not meet the required construction standards. The sand ratio is too high. If we use this, the structure will be weak. I have documented the mix ratio. If something goes wrong, this record will show who made the decision.
Speaker A (Rajan): वो दिन मैं कुछ बोल नहीं पाया, पर इंग्लिश सीखी और अगली बार चुप नहीं रहा। अगर तुम्हारे साथ भी ये होता है, तो रुको मत। ₹1 से शुरू करो आज ही। [That day I couldn't say anything, but I learnt English and next time I wasn't silent. If this happens to you too, don't stop. Start with 1 Rupee today.]
Speaker D (Narrator): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text:
ME NO ENGLISH
INSTALL NOW
English Seekho
Disclaimer...
summary: A construction worker is publicly humiliated by his contractor because he cannot speak English to defend his correct assessment of poor building materials. He uses the English Seekho app to practice speaking with an AI assistant for just 1 rupee. He successfully learns English, confidently confronts his boss, and encourages viewers to download the app.
